description.en: The name of the swimlane group.

description.zh: 用于引流的ASM网关名称，使用时要求必须创建于ASM网关同名的网关规则。对于1.17.2.28版本以上的实例，则可以指定为网关规则的名称，网关规则不一定和ASM网关同名。
description.en: The name of the ASM gateway used for traffic routing. A gateway rule that has the same name as the ASM gateway is required. For ASM instances of v1.17.2.28 or later, you can specify the name of a gateway rule. The gateway rule does not need to have the same name as the ASM gateway.

description.zh: 用于泳道组引流的网关规则所在的命名空间，1.17.2.28版本以上的实例可以指定。
description.en: The namespace of the gateway rule used to route traffic for the swimlane group. This parameter is available for ASM instances of v1.17.2.28 or later.

description.zh: 入口流量类型，目前仅支持ASM网关。
description.en: The type of Ingress traffic. Only ASM gateways are supported.

description.zh: 创建的流量泳道是否是宽松模式。
description.en: Specifies whether to create the swimlane in loose mode.

description.zh: 宽松模式流量泳道组的引流请求头。当IsPermissive参数为true时，此参数为必填。
description.en: The request header for routing traffic in a loose-mode swimlane group. This parameter is required if IsPermissive is set to true.
The ID of the Service Mesh (ASM) instance.

description.zh: 泳道组下关联的服务列表，取值为JSON数组。单个服务的格式为：` $集群名称/$集群id/$namespace/$serviceName`。
description.en: The services to associate with the swimlane group. The value must be a JSON array. The format for a single service is `$ClusterName/$ClusterID/$Namespace/$ServiceName`.

description.zh: 宽松模式泳道组的链路透传请求头。当IsPermissive参数为true时，此参数为必填。
description.en: The request header for passing through requests in a loose-mode swimlane group. This parameter is required if IsPermissive is set to true.
